title: Awful Noise, Then Silence-From the House Next Door - NewsBreak
text:
2 hours ago Around 1 p.m., I was folding towels when a single, sharp crack came from the duplex next door—like a heavy book slammed on tile. Then dead silence. No TV hum, no footsteps. Just my own fridge buzzing. The husband usually games with those big black headphones, so I figured nothing of it until I noticed their dog scratching at the side door and whining.
Five minutes passed. Still nothing. My stomach knotted. I walked over, knocked—no answer. Through the side window I saw a chair tipped on its side and a tablet on the floor with a spiderweb crack. I’m not a hero, but I’m also not ignoring that.
I checked InTown to see if anyone else heard it. Two neighbors on our block posted they’d called 911 after hearing a “bang” and a dog crying. Someone added that a teen had run out the back a minute after, wearing a gray hoodie, and dropped something metallic near the gate.
Police arrived within minutes. Turns out it wasn’t a gas line or fireworks. It was a domestic incident. They escorted out the husband, got the dog water, and cleared the scene. I’m shaken, but grateful people paid attention fast.
